test_cases.title: Start of Mission triggers session establishment in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission procedure.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No active communication session exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an order to establish a communication session.

steps.action: Receive order from trackside to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is approaching the end of an announced radio hole. OBU is in Level 2.

steps.action: Engine rear end reaches the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Previous session terminated due to loss of connection triggers re-establishment
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session was previously established but is now considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection.

steps.action: System detects that the previous session is considered terminated.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a new communication session.

test_cases.title: Driver manually selects RBC contact info outside SoM triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Not in Start of Mission procedure. No active communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects RBC contact information manually.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Session establishment sequence with compatible version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session. Trackside is available and supports a compatible version.

steps.action: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: Safe radio connection is established.

steps.action: OBU sends 'Initiation of communication session' message.
steps.expected: Trackside receives the message and sends system version.

steps.action: OBU receives system version.
steps.expected: OBU considers session established and sends 'Session established report'.

test_cases.title: Session establishment sequence with incompatible version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session. Trackside sends an incompatible system version.

steps.action: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: Safe radio connection is established.

steps.action: OBU sends 'Initiation of communication session' message.
steps.expected: Trackside receives the message and sends incompatible system version.

steps.action: OBU receives incompatible system version.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'No compatible version supported', informs driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Trackside order specifies an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.

steps.action: OBU receives trackside order for FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using FRMCS.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver's single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver elected to use only GSM-R during SoM.

steps.action: OBU initiates session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using GSM-R.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored preferred radio system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. No trackside order or driver single-radio choice. Previous session used FRMCS.

steps.action: OBU initiates session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using FRMCS.

test_cases.title: Memorization of successful radio system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Session establishment is initiated.

steps.action: OBU successfully sets up safe radio connection using GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested).

steps.action: End of Mission is performed while session establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends order to terminate communication session.

steps.action: OBU receives order to terminate communication session from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to passing Level 2 exit
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress. Train is approaching a level transition border from Level 2 to non-Level 2 area.

steps.action: Train's min safe rear end passes the level transition border from Level 2 to non-Level 2 area.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Use stored RBC contact info for 'last known RBC' order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored RBC contact information. Trackside sends order with special RBC identity value for 'last known RBC'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with special RBC identity value.

steps.action: OBU receives order to establish session with 'last known RBC'.
steps.expected: OBU disregards the telephone number in the order and uses stored RBC contact information to contact the RBC.

test_cases.title: Ignore 'last known RBC' order when no stored contact info
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has no stored RBC contact information. Trackside sends order with special RBC identity value for 'last known RBC'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with special RBC identity value.

steps.action: OBU receives order to establish session with 'last known RBC'.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a session.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects 'Start' or manual RBC selection).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows triggering session establishment via driver input or system events.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the first session is still in the 'Establishing' state.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a new Session Establishment request to RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues or fails based on its own logic, but no parallel session attempt is made.

steps.action: Wait for the first session with RBC-A to be fully established.
steps.expected: The session state changes to 'Established'.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the session is 'Established' and no Termination message has been sent.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a new Session Establishment request to RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing sessions when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established. OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or single session logic applies).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish session with RBC-B (not part of an RBC transition order embedded in a handover context that preserves the old session).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is a different RBC than RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger the establishment of a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the session state with RBC-A and the initiation of the session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is terminated. The OBU proceeds to establish the session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Preservation of supervising RBC session during RBC transition order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A (Supervising) is established. OBU is capable of handling multiple simultaneous sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order received, instructing to establish session with RBC-B (Accepting).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports dual-session capability for RBC handover.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an instruction to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send a Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the session states.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A remains established. The OBU initiates the establishment of a session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Forward. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information valid only for the Reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be set to SH mode and cross a balise group in reverse.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the validity direction against the crossing direction (Reverse).

steps.action: Receive information from the balise that is valid only for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

test_cases.title: Ignoring opposite direction information in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Forward. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information valid only for the Forward direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be set to SH mode and cross a balise group in reverse.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the validity direction against the crossing direction (Reverse).

steps.action: Receive information from the balise that is valid only for the Forward direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if time condition met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are active with a repetition period of T. The time since the last MA request is exactly T.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters received from RBC with a repetition period of T_new where T_new <= T (or simply new parameters that trigger the check).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive new MA request parameters while in Level 2.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU checks the time since the last MA request against the new repetition period.

steps.action: Observe the OBU behavior immediately after receiving the parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.title: No SvL defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The train is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: Track description data containing potential SvL candidates (e.g., end of overlap, Danger Point).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be in a state where it supervises an LOA.

steps.action: Ensure the OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority.
steps.expected: The OBU state indicates LOA supervision.

steps.action: Check the defined Supervised Location (SvL) on board.
steps.expected: No SvL is defined. None of the candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Persistence of Level 1 signalling speed restriction until new one received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new speed restriction received initially. Then a new speed restriction of 30 km/h is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive signalling related speed restrictions in Level 1.

steps.action: Verify the active speed restriction.
steps.expected: The active speed restriction is 50 km/h.

steps.action: Wait for a period without receiving any new speed restriction.
steps.expected: The active speed restriction remains 50 km/h.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 30 km/h.
steps.expected: The active speed restriction changes to 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Persistence of Level 1 speed restriction during switch to Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to Level 2. No Level 2 MA accepted yet.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can switch from Level 1 to Level 2.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU enters Level 2 mode.

steps.action: Check the active speed restriction before a Level 2 MA is accepted.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h remains valid.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer the primary constraint (replaced by Level 2 MA logic).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific train performance profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maximum Train Speed value set to 160 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows configuration of Maximum Train Speed.

steps.action: Set the Maximum Train Speed to 160 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the value.

steps.action: Check how the OBU handles this value in speed restriction calculations.
steps.expected: The value is treated as a Static Speed Restriction of the 'Maximum Train Speed' category.

test_cases.title: Initial state of speed restrictions as 'no speed restriction'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a mode where speed restrictions are calculated. No trackside data for speed restrictions has been received yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (initial state).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be observed in its initial state before receiving trackside data.

steps.action: Check the state of speed restrictions before any trackside data is received.
steps.expected: The state is 'no speed restriction'. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A speed restriction is currently active based on trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume initial state (e.g., via MA or specific message).
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside can send an order to clear speed restrictions.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU clears the current speed restriction.

steps.action: Check the state of speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The state is 'no speed restriction'. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt using the same radio system
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection was previously set up via GSM-R. EURORADIO is configured to simulate connection loss.
test_cases.test_inputs: Signal to trigger safe radio connection loss.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is identified as GSM-R for this test.

steps.action: Trigger the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Monitor the radio system used for the reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The reconnection attempt is made using GSM-R, the same system used for the initial successful connection.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempt stops when session is terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for maintaining the session (A.3.1) is short enough to be observed in the test environment.
test_cases.test_inputs: Signal to trigger safe radio connection loss. No successful reconnection occurs.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'defined time' for session maintenance is set to a value that allows observation of the termination logic.

steps.action: Trigger the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait for the defined time to expire without a successful reconnection.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's reconnection attempts after the session termination.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection for this specific session context (as per 3.5.4.3, attempts stop when session is considered terminated).

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session with an RIU exists. The safe radio connection is lost. The train is approaching a location specified in an RIU order to terminate the communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Signal to trigger safe radio connection loss. Train movement to pass the specified location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order contains a specific location for session termination.

steps.action: Trigger the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Move the train so that it passes the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop upon successful reconnection
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. The radio network is available to allow reconnection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Signal to trigger safe radio connection loss. Radio network availability restored.

steps.action: Trigger the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to successfully establish a new safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection once the connection is established.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'Terminate Communication Session' order from the RBC.

steps.action: The RBC sends a 'Terminate Communication Session' order to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition (End of Mission)
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The driver initiates the 'End of Mission' procedure.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver action to select 'Exit SM' or equivalent End of Mission trigger.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition for termination (e.g., End of Mission) is defined in SUBSET-026 and triggers the termination logic.

steps.action: The driver triggers the End of Mission procedure while a session is active.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to the RBC without receiving an explicit trackside order.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No trackside order is received and no internal termination condition is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (passive observation).

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without any trackside order or internal condition change.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of Communication Session' message. The session remains active.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has sent a 'Termination of Communication Session' message. The RBC does not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (simulated lack of acknowledgement).
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the initial 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time elapses without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session. The RBC never sends an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (simulated lack of acknowledgement).
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N (from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1).

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message for the Nth (last allowed) time.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time elapses after the Nth sending without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated internally and requests the release of the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No further repetition after max count reached
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has already repeated the 'Termination of Communication Session' message the defined number of times (N).
test_cases.test_inputs: None.

steps.action: Wait for another fixed waiting time period after the Nth repetition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an (N+1)th 'Termination of Communication Session' message. The session state remains 'terminated' (as per ETC-014).

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and not registered to any network.

steps.action: Power up the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to a GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered after driver enters new network identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where driver input is accepted. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the newly entered GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and communicating with trackside. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and not registered to the target network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Receive a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Default Radio Network type used when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. The OBU's non-volatile memory is cleared or in a state where no Radio Network type is memorised (e.g., after System Failure or first power-up).
test_cases.assumptions: A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Power up the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its operations.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS only installed and not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, driver chose FRMCS only, FRMCS not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. Driver has elected to perform the mission with FRMCS only. FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice, FRMCS not registered and no GSM-R registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. Driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R only installed and not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. Only GSM-R is installed on-board. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'No Connection' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where no safe radio connection is established with any RBC/RIU.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Up' status
test_cases.preconditions: A safe radio connection is successfully established with the relevant RBC/RIU.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the safe radio connection is lost or set-up has failed, and the 'connection status' timer has expired or the final attempt failed during Start of Mission.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Timer start upon first session establishment request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where no communication session is established. The driver initiates Start of Mission in Level 2.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer state is observable via diagnostic interface or log.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's internal state for the 'connection status' timer before the first request is sent.
steps.expected: The timer is not running.

steps.action: Trigger the first request to set up a safe radio connection for session establishment (e.g., via Start of Mission).
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Timer start upon re-establishment request after loss
test_cases.preconditions: A safe radio connection was previously established and is now lost. The OBU is attempting to re-establish the connection.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer state is observable via diagnostic interface or log.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Monitor the 'connection status' timer state when the first re-establishment request is sent.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts immediately upon sending the first request to re-establish the connection.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'No Connection'. A safe radio connection is being set up.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection with the relevant RBC/RIU.
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Up' (Condition [4]).

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed upon timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Up'. The safe radio connection is lost, and the 'connection status' timer is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer duration is known and can be waited out.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The indication status remains 'Connection Up' while the 'connection status' timer is running (to avoid distraction for short disturbances).

steps.action: Wait for the 'connection status' timer to expire without re-establishing the connection.
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' (Condition [2]).

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to No Connection upon release
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Up'.

steps.action: Release the safe radio connection (e.g., via End of Mission or trackside order).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'Connection Up' to 'No Connection' (Condition [5]).

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed upon final failure
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Start of Mission procedure and indicates 'No Connection'.

steps.action: Cause the final attempt to set up the safe radio connection to fail during Start of Mission.
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' (Condition [1]).

test_cases.title: Indication of current RIU status in multi-RIU scenario
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has safe radio connections with two different Radio Infill Units (RIU-A and RIU-B). The train is currently in the infill area of RIU-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports multiple simultaneous RIU sessions as per SUBSET-026-3 §3.9.3.6.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status of the safe radio connection with RIU-A (the current infill area), not RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Revalidation of train position upon passing LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The current train position status is 'invalid'. An LRBG compliant balise group is located ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid'.
steps.expected: The system reports the train position status as 'invalid'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the passage of the LRBG.

steps.action: Check the train position status after passing the LRBG.
steps.expected: The train position status changes to 'valid'. The previously stored invalid position data is deleted and replaced with the new position relative to the LRBG.

test_cases.title: Revalidation of train position upon passing ORBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The current train position status is 'invalid'. An ORBG (Other Reference Balise Group) is located ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid'.
steps.expected: The system reports the train position status as 'invalid'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the passage of the ORBG.

steps.action: Check the train position status after passing the ORBG.
steps.expected: The train position status changes to 'valid'. The previously stored invalid position data is deleted and replaced with the new position relative to the ORBG.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where cab activation is possible. The train consists of two cabs (Cab A and Cab B).

steps.action: Activate Cab A.
steps.expected: The system identifies Cab A as the active cab.

steps.action: Check the defined train orientation.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined such that the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

steps.action: Deactivate Cab A and activate Cab B.
steps.expected: The system identifies Cab B as the active cab.

steps.action: Check the defined train orientation.
steps.expected: The train orientation is updated such that the side of Cab B is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where cab activation is possible. Cab A was the last active cab.

steps.action: Ensure Cab A is active and then deactivate it.
steps.expected: No cab is currently active. The system retains the memory of Cab A as the last active cab.

steps.action: Check the defined train orientation.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined based on the last active cab (Cab A), meaning the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Use of estimated front end for location-based supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. A location-based restriction (e.g., a speed restriction or a signal aspect) is defined at a specific track location.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific function being tested does not have an explicit exception in SUBSET-026 requiring a different reference (like max safe front end or min safe rear end).

steps.action: Position the train such that the 'estimated front end' is just before the location of the restriction, while the 'max safe front end' is already past it.
steps.expected: The OBU does not yet apply the restriction or trigger the associated action, as the reference point (estimated front end) has not passed the location.

steps.action: Move the train forward until the 'estimated front end' passes the location of the restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the restriction or triggers the associated action immediately, confirming that the 'estimated front end' was used as the reference.

test_cases.title: Use of max safe front end for End Section timer start
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an End Section. The End Section timer start location is defined.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 specifies that the max safe front end is used for passing the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Position the train such that the 'estimated front end' has passed the End Section timer start location, but the 'max safe front end' has not yet passed it.
steps.expected: The End Section timer has not started, as the specified reference (max safe front end) has not passed the location.

steps.action: Move the train forward until the 'max safe front end' passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts, confirming that the 'max safe front end' was used as the reference instead of the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with linked LRBG compliant balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. Linking consistency check is enabled on the OBU. The train has passed a balise group marked as 'linked' which is contained in the previously received linking information.

steps.action: Trigger a position report event (e.g., train reaches standstill or periodic timer expires).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC. The LRBG identifier in the report corresponds to the last passed balise group that is marked as 'linked' and present in the linking information.

steps.action: Verify the position reference in the sent message.
steps.expected: The train position is referred to the identified LRBG compliant balise group.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with unlinked LRBG compliant balise group when linking check is disabled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. Linking consistency check is disabled on the OBU. The train has passed a balise group that is not marked as 'unlinked'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report event.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC. The LRBG identifier in the report corresponds to the last passed balise group that is not marked as 'unlinked'.

steps.action: Verify the position reference in the sent message.
steps.expected: The train position is referred to the identified LRBG compliant balise group.

test_cases.title: Rejection of balise group marked as unlinked when linking check is enabled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. Linking consistency check is enabled on the OBU. The train has passed a balise group marked as 'unlinked'. No subsequent LRBG compliant balise group has been passed.

steps.action: Trigger a position report event.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use the 'unlinked' balise group as the LRBG reference. The LRBG identifier in the report is set to 'unknown' or refers to a previous valid LRBG if available, depending on the specific state logic, but specifically, the unlinked group is not used as the primary LRBG reference for a valid position report if no other valid LRBG exists, leading to an 'unknown' status per 3.6.2.2.2.1.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside information referring to the 8th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has successfully reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence. The RBC sends a message (e.g., Movement Authority) referring to the 8th last reported LRBG (the oldest in the window of 8).
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8 as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: Receive a trackside message from the RBC that references the 8th last reported LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data referred to that LRBG.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside information referring to the 9th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has successfully reported 9 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence. The RBC sends a message referring to the 9th last reported LRBG (older than the 8 most recent).
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8. The requirement states 'at least eight', implying the system must handle the defined window. Typically, references outside the known/valid window are rejected or treated as unknown. Based on 'accept... referring to one of at least eight', it implies the capability to handle the recent 8. References to older ones are not guaranteed to be accepted if they are no longer in the active reference set.

steps.action: Receive a trackside message from the RBC that references the 9th last reported LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message or treats the location reference as invalid/unknown, as it is outside the minimum required window of 8 recent LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Position reporting after passing LRBG compliant balise group with message content processing
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an LRBG compliant balise group. The OBU is configured to report position upon passage of such a group (if no other parameters are set) or triggers a report.

steps.action: The train passes the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU reads the balise message.

steps.action: The OBU processes the content of the passed balise group and any previous LRBG compliant balise groups.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its internal state with the new LRBG reference.

steps.action: The OBU sends the position report.
steps.expected: The position report is sent only after the message content has been taken into account, and the LRBG identifier in the report is the newly passed compliant balise group.

test_cases.title: Filtreleme: Tren yönüne uygun verinin kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, nominal yönde hareket eden bir tren konfigürasyonunda çalışmaktadır. Ray kenarı cihazı, nominal yöne ait geçerli bir mesaj yayınlamaktadır.

steps.expected: OBU, mesajı kabul eder ve ilgili veriyi işler.

test_cases.title: Filtreleme: Tren yönüne aykırı verinin yok sayılması

test_cases.test_inputs: Ters yöne ait geçerli bir balise mesajı.

steps.expected: OBU, mesajı yok sayar (ignore) ve veriyi işlemez.

test_cases.title: Yön belirsizliği: Tek yönlü verinin reddedilmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Sadece nominal yöne geçerli olan bir balise mesajı.

steps.action: Yön belirsizliği durumunda, sadece nominal yöne geçerli olan bir balise mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı reddeder (reject).

test_cases.title: Yön belirsizliği: İki yönlü verinin değerlendirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Tren yönü, ray kenarı cihazının yönüne ilişkilendirilememektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Her iki yöne de geçerli olan bir balise mesajı.

steps.action: Yön belirsizliği durumunda, her iki yöne de geçerli olan bir balise mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı değerlendirir (evaluate) ve veriyi işler.

test_cases.title: Sürekli Profil: Artımsal mesafe ve değer geçerliliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, önceki bir mesajdan gelen profil verilerini (value(0)) içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir profil mesajı: value(1) ve distance(1) (value(0)'dan value(1)'e mesafe), value(2) ve distance(2) (value(1)'den value(2)'ye mesafe).

steps.action: Yeni profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, distance(1) aralığında önceki veriyi (value(0)) kullanır. distance(1) ile distance(1)+distance(2) aralığında value(1)'i kullanır. distance(1)+distance(2) sonrası için value(2)'yi kullanır.

test_cases.title: Sürekli Profil: Sıfır mesafedeki değerin dikkate alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, aktif bir profil verisi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir profil mesajı: value(1) ve distance(1)=0.

steps.action: distance(1) değeri 0 olan bir profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, value(1)'i dikkate alır ve geçerli profil verisi olarak işler.

test_cases.title: Sürekli Profil: Son değerin sınırsız geçerliliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, profil verisi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir profil mesajı: value(1) ve distance(1). value(1) 'end-of-profile' değeri değildir.

steps.action: Yeni profil mesajı okunur ve tren, distance(1) mesafesini aşar.
steps.expected: OBU, distance(1) mesafesinden sonra da value(1)'i sınırsız mesafe boyunca geçerli kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Konum Verisi: Artımsal mesafe ve önceki veri kullanımı
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, önceki bir mesajdan gelen konum verilerini içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir konum mesajı: value(1) ve distance(1).

steps.action: Yeni konum mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, distance(1) aralığında önceki konum verisini kullanır. distance(1) sonrası için value(1)'i kullanır. Mesafeler artımsal olarak yorumlanır.

test_cases.title: Sürekli Olmayan Profil: Eleman başlangıçları ve örtüşme
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, önceki profil verilerini içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir sürekli olmayan profil mesajı: element(1) (value(1), length(1)) ve distance(1); element(2) (value(2), length(2)) ve distance(2). distance(2) < length(1) olacak şekilde ayarlanır (örtüşme).

steps.action: Yeni sürekli olmayan profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, element(1)'in başlangıcını önceki veriye göre distance(1) kadar ileride, element(2)'nin başlangıcını element(1)'in başlangıcından distance(2) kadar ileride belirler. Elemanların örtüşmesini kabul eder ve her elemanı kendi uzunluğu kadar geçerli sayar.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı Bilgisi: Balise grupları arası mesafeler
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bağlantı bilgisi içeren bir mesaj beklemektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı mesajı: Balise Grubu A (value_A), Balise Grubu B (value_B). distance(1) = A'ya kadar mesafe, distance(2) = A'dan B'ye mesafe.

steps.action: Bağlantı mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, distance(1)'i ilk balise grubuna (A) kadar mesafe olarak, distance(2)'yi A ve B balise grupları arasındaki mesafe olarak yorumlar. Her balise grubu için ilgili bağlantı verisini (value_A, value_B) saklar.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information

steps.action: Detect balise group BG1 and process its linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy of BG1 as 10m.

steps.action: Verify the location accuracy value associated with BG1 in the OBU memory.
steps.expected: The value is 10m, matching the linking information.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group BG2 is configured without linking information providing location accuracy. The applicable National Value for location accuracy is 20m.
test_cases.test_inputs: No linking information for BG2. National Value = 20m.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG2 such that it becomes the LRBG or ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG2.

steps.action: Verify the location accuracy value associated with BG2.

steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG3.

steps.action: Verify the location accuracy value associated with BG3.

test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of balise group BG1 as 10m from initial linking information.

steps.action: Receive new linking information for BG1 specifying a different location accuracy (15m).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the new linking information.

steps.action: Verify the location accuracy value associated with BG1.
steps.expected: The value remains 10m and is not updated to 15m.

steps.expected: The OBU stops checking linking consistency.

steps.action: Verify the location accuracy value associated with BG1.
steps.expected: The value remains 10m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy remains unchanged when new National Values become applicable

test_cases.test_inputs: Update to make a new National Value applicable.

steps.action: Apply the change that makes the new National Value (25m) applicable.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the new National Value applicability.

steps.action: Verify the location accuracy value associated with BG1.
steps.expected: The value remains 10m and is not updated to 25m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Reference balise group BG1 has location accuracy 10m. Odometer over-reading amount is 5m, under-reading amount is 5m. No consist-length-related situation applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position = 100m from BG1.

steps.action: Calculate the train front end position confidence interval based on the given parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the min safe front end and max safe front end.

steps.action: Verify the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: Min safe front end is 100m - (10m + 5m) = 85m from BG1 (rear of estimated).

steps.action: Verify the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: Max safe front end is 100m + (10m + 5m) = 115m from BG1 (advance of estimated).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked

test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise detections: BG1, then BG2.

steps.action: Detect BG1.
steps.expected: SOLR is set to BG1 (if it is the reference or announced in linking info).

steps.action: Detect BG2, which is announced in linking information.
steps.expected: SOLR is updated to BG2, as it is the most recently received balise group announced in linking information.

steps.action: Detect BG1.
steps.expected: SOLR is set to BG1.

steps.action: Detect BG2.
steps.expected: SOLR is updated to BG2, as it is the last received balise group.

steps.action: Verify the sequence of operations.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into location items

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using linking distance

steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new distance by subtracting the linking distance from the original distance.

steps.action: Verify the relocated distance of the location item.
steps.expected: The new distance is 100m - 50m = 50m from the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has location items referred to FRBG. A new SOLR is established. Linking information is not available or not applicable. Travelled distance between FRBG and SOLR is known.

steps.action: Trigger relocation of location items to the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new distance by subtracting the travelled distance from the original distance.

steps.action: Verify the relocated distance of the location item.
steps.expected: The new distance is 100m - 30m = 70m from the SOLR.
