steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display activation and deactivation by driver
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where geographical position information is available and valid. The geographical position display is currently inactive.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to display geographical position. Driver request to stop geographical position display.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows the driver to toggle the geographical position display.

steps.action: Verify the state of the geographical position display before any driver request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the OBU screen.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the estimated front end of the train in relation to the track kilometre.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled from reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received geographical position information referencing a specific balise group (Reference BG) with a known offset to the track kilometre reference. The train is positioned exactly at the Reference BG.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geographical position data: Reference BG ID, Offset to track km reference (e.g., 100m), Track km reference value (e.g., 10.000 km). Train movement: 50 meters forward from Reference BG.
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre reference value and offset are known and stable. The OBU's internal distance counter is accurate for the test segment.

steps.action: Initialize the OBU with geographical position information where the track kilometre reference is 100 meters from the Reference BG in the direction of travel. Position the train at the Reference BG.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the initial geographical position. The displayed or internal position corresponds to the track kilometre reference minus the offset (or plus, depending on direction, but effectively the position relative to the track km marker is established based on the offset).

steps.action: Move the train 50 meters forward from the Reference BG.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the geographical position by adding the 50 meters travelled to the position calculated from the reference. The new geographical position reflects the train's movement relative to the track kilometre reference.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start and calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is stationary. The OBU is in a mode where Roll Away Protection supervision is active (e.g., Standstill). The National/Default Value for roll-away distance is set to 10 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 5 m in the forward direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'location where supervision was started' is the current train position at the moment the standstill condition is detected.

steps.action: Initiate the condition that triggers Roll Away Protection supervision (e.g., bring the train to a complete stop).
steps.expected: The OBU starts the supervision of the roll-away distance. The remaining distance is calculated as the National Value (10 m) minus the estimated distance travelled (0 m), resulting in 10 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m using the odometer input.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance. The remaining distance is calculated as 10 m - 5 m = 5 m.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start with National Value
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance to run in SR mode is determined by the National/Default Value (e.g., 500 m). The odometer under-reading and over-reading amounts are 0 m for this test.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 100 m in the forward direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The virtual train front position is created at the moment SR mode is entered or the supervision is re-started.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode or trigger a re-start of the SR distance supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train front position. The remaining distance to the end of the SR distance is calculated as the National Value (500 m) minus the estimated distance travelled (0 m), resulting in 500 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the virtual train front position. The remaining distance is calculated as 500 m - 100 m = 400 m.

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Post Trip (PT) mode. The National/Default Value for maximum distance for reversing is set to 20 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 10 m in the reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The supervision starts when the reversing movement is initiated in PT mode.

steps.action: Initiate a reversing movement in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the supervision of the reversing distance. The remaining distance is calculated as the National Value (20 m) minus the estimated distance travelled (0 m), resulting in 20 m.

steps.action: Move the train in reverse by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance. The remaining distance is calculated as 20 m - 10 m = 10 m.

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision with odometer under-reading correction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible mode. The SR distance is 100 m. The odometer under-reading amount since the function was activated is 5 m. The estimated distance travelled is 0 m at start.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 0 m (static check of calculation logic).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'max safe front end position' is used for the calculation involving under-reading.

steps.action: Start the SR distance supervision with a known odometer under-reading of 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end position. The calculation is: Supervised Distance (100 m) - Estimated Distance Travelled (0 m) - Odometer Under-reading (5 m) = 95 m.

test_cases.title: SR distance supervision with odometer over-reading correction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible mode. The SR distance is 100 m. The odometer over-reading amount since the supervision was started is 5 m. The estimated distance travelled is 0 m at start.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 0 m (static check of calculation logic).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'min safe front end position' is used for the calculation involving over-reading.

steps.action: Start the SR distance supervision with a known odometer over-reading of 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end position. The calculation is: Supervised Distance (100 m) - Estimated Distance Travelled (0 m) + Odometer Over-reading (5 m) = 105 m.

test_cases.title: Zero distance supervision after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Selective Stop (SB) or Post Trip (PT) mode. There is no valid train position stored on-board. The Override function is triggered.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 1 m in the forward direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'former EOA/LOA' is defined as the virtual train front position at the time of Override activation.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function while in SB/PT mode without a valid stored train position.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of a zero distance from the virtual train front position to the former EOA/LOA. The remaining distance is 0 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the train has moved away from the virtual position. The remaining distance becomes negative (or the trip condition is met), indicating the train has overpassed the supervised zero distance.

test_cases.title: Trip suppression distance supervision after Override
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where Override can be triggered. The National/Default Value for trip suppression distance after Override is 50 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement of 25 m in the forward direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The supervision starts immediately after the Override function is triggered.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the supervision of the trip suppression distance. The remaining distance is calculated as the National Value (50 m) minus the estimated distance travelled (0 m), resulting in 50 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 25 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance. The remaining distance is calculated as 50 m - 25 m = 25 m.

test_cases.title: MA reddedilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, FS modunda çalışmaktadır. Geçerli bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Non-infill). SSP/gradient verileri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan (estimated front end) denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır (örneğin, SSP verisi MA'nın son 100 metresinden önce bitmektedir).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini ön uçtan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamadığı bir MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mod profili geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun DMI ekranı ve iç durum kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilmediğine dair bir hata durumu veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili, reddedilen MA'ya göre değil, önceki geçerli MA'ya göre güncellenir.

test_cases.title: MA reddedilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, FS modunda çalışmaktadır. Geçerli bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Infill). SSP/gradient verileri, infill konum referans noktasından (infill location reference) denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Infill konum referans noktası ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (infill konum referansından denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamadığı bir Infill MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mod profili geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun DMI ekranı ve iç durum kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilmediğine dair bir hata durumu veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili, reddedilen MA'ya göre değil, önceki geçerli MA'ya göre güncellenir.

test_cases.title: MA reddedilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Supervised Manoeuvre, ters yön)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, FS modunda çalışmaktadır. Geçerli bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Supervised Manoeuvre parçası). Geçerlilik yönü, mevcut tren yönünün tersinedir. SSP/gradient verileri, yeni tren yönüne göre tahmini ön uçtan (estimated front end derived from new train orientation) denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni tren yönüne göre tahmini ön uç konumu OBU tarafından doğru olarak türetilmiştir.

steps.action: SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (yeni yön için tahmini ön uçtan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamadığı bir MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mod profili geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun DMI ekranı ve iç durum kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilmediğine dair bir hata durumu veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili, reddedilen MA'ya göre değil, önceki geçerli MA'ya göre güncellenir.

test_cases.title: MA kabulü: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsıyor (Normal)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, FS modunda çalışmaktadır. Geçerli bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Non-infill). SSP/gradient verileri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan (estimated front end) denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu ve denetlenen konum (supervised location) konumları OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini ön uçtan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsadığı bir MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profilini (varsa) kabul eder. Yeni MA geçerli hale gelir.

steps.action: OBU'nun DMI ekranı ve iç durum kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: Yeni MA'nın kabul edildiğine dair bir durum gözlemlenir. Hız profili, yeni MA'ya göre güncellenir.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Static Speed Profile from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored Static Speed Profile (SSP) exists from location L1 to L100. New SSP is received with start location L50.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SSP message with start location L50 and different speed values than stored SSP.
test_cases.assumptions: The new SSP is valid for the current train orientation.

steps.action: Transmit the new Static Speed Profile information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new SSP.

steps.action: Query the stored SSP data for the segment between L1 and L50.
steps.expected: The stored SSP data for L1 to L50 remains unchanged from the previous state.

steps.action: Query the stored SSP data for the segment from L50 onwards.
steps.expected: The stored SSP data from L50 onwards is replaced by the new SSP information.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored linking information exists for balise groups BG1 to BG10. New non-infill linking information is received with reference balise group BG5.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information message with reference BG5.
test_cases.assumptions: The new linking information is non-infill.

steps.action: Transmit the new non-infill linking information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new linking information.

steps.action: Query the stored linking information for balise groups BG1 to BG4.
steps.expected: The stored linking information for BG1 to BG4 remains unchanged.

steps.action: Query the stored linking information for balise groups BG5 and onwards.
steps.expected: The stored linking information from BG5 onwards is replaced by the new linking information.

test_cases.title: Complete replacement of Route Suitability Loading Gauge
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored route suitability loading gauge information exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: New route suitability loading gauge information.

steps.action: Transmit the new route suitability loading gauge information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new information.

steps.action: Query the stored route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: The entire stored route suitability loading gauge information is replaced by the new information.

test_cases.title: Resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored Speed Restriction to ensure Permitted Braking Distance (PBD) information exists from L1 to L100.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L50.

steps.action: Transmit the trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond L50.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request.

steps.action: Query the stored PBD speed restriction information for the segment L1 to L50.
steps.expected: The stored PBD information for L1 to L50 remains unchanged.

steps.action: Query the stored PBD speed restriction information for the segment beyond L50.
steps.expected: The stored PBD information beyond L50 is reset to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resume initial state for all Station Platform track conditions via single request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored track condition information of type Station Platform exists at multiple locations.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for all stored Station Platform track conditions.

steps.action: Transmit the single trackside request to resume initial state for all Station Platform track conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request.

steps.action: Query the stored Station Platform track condition information.
steps.expected: All stored Station Platform track condition information is reset to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with same validity direction applies replacement rules
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Current train orientation is forward. Stored location based information exists. New Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with validity direction forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction matching current train orientation.

steps.action: Transmit the Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction matching the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the authorisation.

steps.action: Verify the handling of location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of §3.7.3.1 to the location based information associated with the new Movement Authority.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction deletes all location based information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Current train orientation is forward. Stored location based information exists. New Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with validity direction reverse.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction opposite to current train orientation.

steps.action: Transmit the Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the authorisation.

steps.action: Query the stored location based information.
steps.expected: All previously stored location based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA request parameters from RBC. Track description data.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows monitoring of the MA request message content sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Trigger an MA request by selecting 'Start' on the driver's desk.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC. The message contains the reason 'Start selected by driver'.

steps.action: Modify the track description to cause a deletion of a part of the track description (excluding situations a, b, f, k of A.3.4) while the 'Start' reason is still applicable (no MA received yet).
steps.expected: A new MA request is sent to the RBC. The message contains both reasons: 'Start selected by driver' and 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA with a perturbation location is stored. The train is moving towards the perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with perturbation location. Train speed data.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location is calculated and stored by the OBU. The train front position is accurately tracked.

steps.action: Move the train such that the train front passes the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion (d_MAR).
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC. The reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached' is included in the request.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA with a Section timer is stored. The train is within the section.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Section timer. Time data.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer is running. The triggering time criterion (defined time before expiration) is configured.

steps.action: Wait until the moment defined by the Section timer criterion (defined time before the Section timer expires) is reached.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC. The reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached' is included in the request.

test_cases.title: MA request on track description deletion
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA and track description are stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Track description update causing deletion (e.g., MA shortening).
test_cases.assumptions: The deletion scenario corresponds to one of the situations in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4, excluding a, b, f, and k.

steps.action: Apply a track description update that results in the deletion of a part of the track description according to A.3.4 (excluding a, b, f, k).
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC. The reason 'Track description deletion' is included in the request.

test_cases.title: No MA request on excluded track description deletions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA and track description are stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Track description update causing deletion corresponding to situation 'a' of A.3.4.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment can simulate the specific deletion situation 'a' from A.3.4.

steps.action: Apply a track description update that results in the deletion of a part of the track description corresponding to situation 'a' of A.3.4.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC due to this specific deletion event.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location and time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving forward at a speed sufficient to cross the location during the test window.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end crosses the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the End Section timer.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU for the End Section timer status.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is active and counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer expiry consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The train is moving within the End Section. The MA includes a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with LOA and non-zero target speed. Time-out value set to a short duration for testing.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not yet reached the End Section timer stop location.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position.

steps.action: Inspect the location based information stored on-board.
steps.expected: Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero (LOA becomes EOA).

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received via radio.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp and LOA speed time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The system clock is synchronized with the RBC time stamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the LOA speed timer at the value of the time stamp of the message.

steps.action: Verify the start time of the LOA speed timer.
steps.expected: The timer start time matches the message time stamp.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA information including LOA speed time-out.
test_cases.assumptions: The train passes the first balise of the group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the LOA speed timer at the moment of passage.

steps.action: Verify the start time of the LOA speed timer.
steps.expected: The timer start time corresponds to the time of passage over the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer expiry consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The MA includes a non-zero speed associated with the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with LOA speed and time-out value set to a short duration.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the LOA.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the speed associated with the LOA to zero.

steps.action: Check the type of the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The LOA becomes an EOA.

steps.action: Verify the Supervised Location (SvL).
steps.expected: The SvL is defined according to §3.8.4.5 (e.g., Danger Point or End of End Section).

steps.action: Inspect the location based information stored on-board.
steps.expected: Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving forward.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end crosses the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the Overlap timer.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU for the Overlap timer status.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is active and counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and time-out value 'infinite'.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving forward.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end crosses the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the Overlap timer.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU for the Overlap timer status.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started, even though the time-out value is 'infinite'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiry consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap, release speed, and LOA with non-zero target speed. Time-out value set to a short duration.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is within the Overlap area.

steps.action: Wait for the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the overlap information.

steps.action: Check the release speed associated with the Overlap.
steps.expected: The release speed is deleted.

steps.action: Verify the Supervised Location (SvL).
steps.expected: The SvL is redetermined according to §3.8.4.5.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The non-zero target speed is set to zero (LOA becomes EOA).

steps.action: Inspect the location based information stored on-board.
steps.expected: Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiry upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The train is moving within the Overlap area.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap and finite time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train can be brought to a standstill.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer value as greater than its time-out value.

steps.action: Check the consequences of the Overlap time-out.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the consequences defined in §3.8.4.4.2 (deletion of overlap, release speed, SvL redetermination, target speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiry when new MA start location is in rear
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is running. The train is positioned such that its max safe front end is ahead of a potential Overlap timer start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location in rear of the train's max safe front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode.

steps.action: Receive a new MA with an Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer value has exceeded its time-out value.

steps.action: Check the consequences of the Overlap time-out.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the consequences defined in §3.8.4.4.2 (deletion of overlap, release speed, SvL redetermination, target speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid Overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an Overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and End of End Section are also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap, Danger Point, and End of End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The Overlap timer is running and has not expired.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) defined on-board.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination without Overlap but with Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The MA does not include an Overlap (or it has timed out). A Danger Point is defined. An End of End Section is also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Danger Point and End of End Section, no valid Overlap.
test_cases.assumptions: The Overlap timer is not running or has expired.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) defined on-board.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination without Overlap or Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The MA does not include an Overlap (or it has timed out) and does not include a Danger Point. An End of End Section is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End of End Section, no valid Overlap, no Danger Point.
test_cases.assumptions: The Overlap timer is not running or has expired.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) defined on-board.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision mode

test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and complete.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in FS mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving (AD) mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA from a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and complete.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in AD mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision (LS) mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA from a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and complete.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in LS mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in Non-Operational mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Non-Operational (NO) mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA from a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and complete.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in NO mode.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group referenced by the infill MA is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA referencing a specific main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is stored in the OBU.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that references a main signal balise group for which linking information is available.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group referenced by the infill MA is NOT available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA referencing a specific main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is missing or corrupted in the OBU.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that references a main signal balise group for which linking information is not available.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored a valid MA with specific speed restrictions and section data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new non-infill MA message from the RBC or a main-signal balise group with different data values.

steps.action: Record the current stored MA data (sections, speeds, SvL) in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU holds the initial MA data.

steps.action: Inject a new non-infill MA message with distinct data values (e.g., different section lengths or speeds).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data from the previous MA has been replaced by the new data. No remnants of the old MA exist.

test_cases.title: Infill MA replaces only data beyond the next main signal
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode and has stored a valid MA. The linking information for the next main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message referencing the next main signal balise group, with data differing from the stored MA beyond that point.

steps.action: Record the current stored MA data, specifically the sections before and after the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU holds the initial MA data.

steps.action: Inject the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: Data before the announced balise group at the next main signal remains unchanged. Data beyond that balise group is replaced by the new infill data.

test_cases.title: New MA section starts at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message.

steps.action: Inject the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the structure of the stored MA sections.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts exactly at the infill location reference (the balise group at the next main signal). The section prior to this point is terminated or adjusted accordingly, and the new section begins at this reference point.

test_cases.title: MA with SvL received while supervising LOA is treated as shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA). Location-based information (e.g., speed restrictions, text) is stored beyond the current train position.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message defining an SvL (not an LOA).

steps.action: Verify the OBU is currently supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates LOA supervision.

steps.action: Inject the new MA message defining an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal handling of the MA update.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this update as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information listed in Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The relevant location-based information beyond the new SvL has been deleted from the OBU memory.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode with a valid MA. Linking information announces a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information from a balise group.

steps.action: Inject the repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the repositioning information.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal handling of the MA update.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT treat this event as an MA shortening. No deletion of location-based information occurs solely due to this repositioning.

test_cases.title: New MA with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in FS mode with a valid MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message ending with an LOA.

steps.action: Inject the new MA message ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal handling of the MA update.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT treat this event as an MA shortening. No deletion of location-based information occurs solely due to the reception of this LOA-based MA.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (tren sınırı gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili Mode Profile ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumunun ötesindedir (tren sınırı gerisindedir).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'inden geridedir.

steps.action: RBC, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı (ve varsa Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini) içeren bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği alır ve trenin ön ucunu önerilen MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i ile karşılaştırır.

steps.action: OBU'nun kararını gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği kabul eder ve önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı, ilgili Mode Profile'ı ve SH alanı balise grubu listesini (varsa) yeni MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıtı gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin reddi (tren sınırı ötesinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili Mode Profile ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumunun gerisindedir (tren sınırı ötesindedir).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'inden ötededir.

steps.action: RBC, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı (ve varsa Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini) içeren bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği alır ve trenin ön ucunu önerilen MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i ile karşılaştırır.

steps.action: OBU'nun kararını gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği reddeder. Önceki MA, Mode Profile ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi (varsa) geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıtı gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin reddedildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (tren sınırı tam sınırda)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili Mode Profile ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumuyla aynıdır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i ile aynı konumdadır. 'In rear' (geride) ifadesi, sınırın ötesinde olmamak olarak yorumlanır; dolayısıyla sınırda kabul edilir.

steps.action: RBC, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı (ve varsa Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini) içeren bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği alır ve trenin ön ucunu önerilen MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i ile karşılaştırır.

steps.action: OBU'nun kararını gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği kabul eder ve önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı, ilgili Mode Profile'ı ve SH alanı balise grubu listesini (varsa) yeni MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıtı gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores announcement for unsupported infill medium
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 operation and has received valid movement authority and speed restrictions from a previous balise group. The OBU is not equipped with the specific infill transmission medium (e.g., Radio Infill) requested by the upcoming announcement balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Announcement balise group requesting an infill medium not present on the OBU (e.g., Radio Infill).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's configuration correctly reflects the absence of the requested infill medium.

steps.action: Train passes the announcement balise group that requests an infill transmission medium not equipped on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the announcement information. No error or alarm related to the missing medium is triggered.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's movement authority and speed supervision status after passing the announcement balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to supervise the train according to the previously received information (movement authority and speed restrictions remain unchanged).

test_cases.title: Infill information ignored after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. A loop infill area is active and transmitting infill information. The next main signal balise group is identified in the infill data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data stream, Balise group telegram for the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The loop infill unit continues to transmit data even after the train passes the main signal balise group to simulate a timing overlap or delayed stop.

steps.action: The OBU reads the balise group corresponding to the next main signal indicated in the infill information.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the balise group message and updates its state accordingly.

steps.action: The OBU receives further infill information from the loop after having read the main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information and does not apply it to the movement authority or speed profile.

test_cases.title: Infill information ignored after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. A loop infill area is active. The OBU has passed the location of the next main signal balise group without reading it (missed balise).
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data stream, Simulated missed balise event.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU detects the missed balise based on position and time logic defined in the specification.

steps.action: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the appropriate reaction for a missed balise (e.g., braking or state change) and marks the infill area as terminated.

steps.action: The OBU receives further infill information from the loop after detecting the missed balise.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information and does not apply it to the movement authority or speed profile.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores RIU session order when GSM-R is not installed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured without a GSM-R radio system. The OBU is in Level 1 operation.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a specific RIU.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group containing the order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to establish a communication session with the RIU.

steps.action: The train reaches the location indicated in the order.
steps.expected: No communication session is active with any RIU.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates old RIU session and establishes new one upon reaching location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation with GSM-R installed. An existing communication session is active with RIU-A. A balise group is read containing an order to establish a session with RIU-B at a specific location ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data with order for RIU-B and location L.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group with the order for RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the order and the location L. The session with RIU-A remains active.

steps.action: The train reaches location L.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with RIU-A.

steps.action: The OBU attempts to establish a session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: A communication session is established with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores RIU-initiated session order in degraded single-session mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU is in a degraded situation where it can handle only one GSM-R communication session. An existing session is active with RIU-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: A message from RIU-B requesting to establish a communication session.

steps.action: RIU-B sends an order to establish a communication session to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order.

steps.action: Check the status of communication sessions.
steps.expected: The session with RIU-A remains active. No session is established with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: OBU sends entry notification to RIU upon passing infill area start
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with RIU-A. The OBU has received an order via balise to enter an infill area managed by RIU-A at location L_start.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement past location L_start.

steps.action: The train passes location L_start.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to RIU-A indicating entry into the infill area.

test_cases.title: OBU sends exit notification to RIU upon reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an infill area managed by RIU-A. The order specified the next main signal balise group as BG_X.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement past balise group BG_X.

steps.action: The train reads balise group BG_X.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to RIU-A indicating that the next main signal balise group has been read.

test_cases.title: OBU sends exit notification to RIU upon detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an infill area managed by RIU-A. The order specified the next main signal balise group as BG_X. The train passes the location of BG_X without reading it (e.g., due to speed or detection failure).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement past the location of BG_X without successful read.

steps.action: The OBU detects that BG_X was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to RIU-A indicating that the next main signal balise group was missed.

test_cases.title: OBU includes required fields in messages to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with RIU-A. The OBU is about to send a message to RIU-A (e.g., entry notification).

steps.action: The OBU sends a message to RIU-A.
steps.expected: The message contains the OBU's ETCS-ID.

steps.action: Inspect the message content.
steps.expected: The message contains a position report.

steps.action: Inspect the message content.
steps.expected: The message contains the identifier of the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Inspect the message content.
steps.expected: The message contains a time stamp.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects inconsistent radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with RIU-A. The OBU is receiving infill information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill data with an invalid or inconsistent time stamp or other parameters violating §3.16.3.1/3.16.3.3.

steps.action: RIU-A sends infill data with an inconsistent time stamp.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the inconsistency.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the inconsistent infill data to its movement authority or speed profile.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores further infill data after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an infill area. The OBU has just read the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Additional infill data related to the previous infill area sent by RIU-A.

steps.action: RIU-A sends further infill information related to the balise group that was just read.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores this information.

steps.action: Check the OBU's movement authority.
steps.expected: The movement authority is not modified by the ignored infill data.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores further infill data after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in an infill area. The OBU has just detected that the next main signal balise group was missed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Additional infill data related to the missed balise group sent by RIU-A.

steps.action: RIU-A sends further infill information related to the missed balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores this information.

steps.action: Check the OBU's movement authority.
steps.expected: The movement authority is not modified by the ignored infill data.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates RIU session upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is active with RIU-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: A terminate session order from trackside (via balise or RIU).

steps.action: The OBU receives an order to terminate the communication session with RIU-A.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with RIU-A.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates RIU session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is active with RIU-A. The OBU is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to Level 2 or Level 0.

steps.action: The OBU transitions out of Level 1 (e.g., to Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with RIU-A.

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can receive and process emergency messages (e.g., Full Supervision). A communication session with the RBC is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: An emergency message (e.g., Unconditional Emergency Stop) with a specific NID_EM value (e.g., 101).
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC or test equipment can capture and verify the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU.

steps.action: Send an emergency message to the OBU with NID_EM set to 101.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink communication from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that quotes the identification number 101.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of repeated emergency message with same ID
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with NID_EM 202.
test_cases.test_inputs: A repeated emergency message with the same NID_EM value (202).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU replaces the previous message with the new one as per 3.10.1.3.1, but the acknowledgement requirement for the received message ID remains.

steps.action: Send a second emergency message to the OBU with NID_EM set to 202.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink communication from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that quotes the identification number 202.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of emergency message with different ID
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state to receive emergency messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: An emergency message with NID_EM set to 303.

steps.action: Send an emergency message to the OBU with NID_EM set to 303.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink communication from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that quotes the identification number 303.

test_cases.title: MA rejection during active emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can accept movement authorities (e.g., Full Supervision). An unconditional emergency stop message has been received and accepted, causing a train trip. The emergency stop has not yet been revoked.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new Movement Authority (MA) message from the RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is configured to send a new MA while the emergency stop is active.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new Movement Authority. The current emergency stop state remains active.

test_cases.title: MA acceptance after emergency stop revocation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has accepted an emergency stop message. The emergency stop has been revoked by the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new Movement Authority (MA) message from the RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where it can accept a new MA after the revocation (e.g., driver has acknowledged the trip and the system is ready for a new MA).

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU after the revocation of the emergency stop.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new Movement Authority.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges revocation of a single emergency message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 with an established radio session. An active emergency message (ID: EM-1) is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Revocation message (Message 18) with NID_EM = EM-1 and M_ACK = 1.
test_cases.assumptions: The general acknowledgement procedure requires the OBU to send a message referencing the timestamp of the received revocation message.

steps.action: Send a Revocation of Emergency Stop message (Message 18) to the OBU with NID_EM set to the ID of the active emergency message and M_ACK set to 1.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the revocation and removes the emergency message from its active list.

steps.action: Monitor the radio communication channel for an acknowledgement message from the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the trackside. The acknowledgement message refers to the timestamp of the received revocation message.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges revocation of multiple emergency messages independently
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 with an established radio session. Two active emergency messages (ID: EM-1 and ID: EM-2) are stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two Revocation messages: one for EM-1, one for EM-2, both with M_ACK = 1.
test_cases.assumptions: Revocation of one message does not affect the management of other emergency messages (per 3.10.3.3).

steps.action: Send a Revocation of Emergency Stop message for EM-1 with M_ACK = 1.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message referencing the timestamp of the first revocation message.

steps.action: Send a Revocation of Emergency Stop message for EM-2 with M_ACK = 1.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a second acknowledgement message referencing the timestamp of the second revocation message. The first emergency message remains revoked, and the second is now revoked.

test_cases.title: OBU does not acknowledge revocation if M_ACK is 0
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 with an established radio session. An active emergency message (ID: EM-1) is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Revocation message (Message 18) with NID_EM = EM-1 and M_ACK = 0.
test_cases.assumptions: According to 3.16.3.5.1, acknowledgement is only sent if the message includes a request for acknowledgement (M_ACK = 1).

steps.action: Send a Revocation of Emergency Stop message to the OBU with NID_EM set to EM-1 and M_ACK set to 0.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the revocation (removes EM-1) but does not send an acknowledgement message to the trackside.

test_cases.title: On-Sight modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem On-Sight (OS) modundadır. Ulusal OS hız limiti 30 km/h olarak yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da OS hız limiti 20 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından gelen ve OS hız limitini 20 km/h olarak içeren MA işlenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, izleme için geçerli hız limitini 20 km/h olarak belirler.

steps.action: Tren hızı 25 km/h'a çıkarılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, hız limitinin (20 km/h) aşıldığını algılar ve fren komutu üretir.

test_cases.title: Limited Supervision modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal değere önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem Limited Supervision (LS) modundadır. Ulusal LS hız limiti 100 km/h olarak yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da LS hız limiti 80 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından gelen ve LS hız limitini 80 km/h olarak içeren MA işlenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, izleme için geçerli hız limitini 80 km/h olarak belirler.

test_cases.title: Shunting modunda ray kenarı hız limitinin ulusal değere önceliği

test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen MA'da SH hız limiti 15 km/h olarak tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından gelen ve SH hız limitini 15 km/h olarak içeren MA işlenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, izleme için geçerli hız limitini 15 km/h olarak belirler.

steps.action: Tren hızı 20 km/h'a çıkarılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, hız limitinin (15 km/h) aşıldığını algılar ve fren komutu üretir.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı hız limiti ulusal değerden yüksek olduğunda öncelik

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation upon receipt of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to trackside. No active PBD speed restriction is currently applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-continuous profile containing PBD data (start/end location, PBD distance, brake type, gradient) is sent from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside profile is valid and within the operational limits of the OBU.

steps.action: Send a valid PBD profile from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU computes and applies a speed restriction value based on the received PBD data.

steps.action: Verify the applied speed restriction value against the expected calculation for the given inputs.
steps.expected: The applied speed restriction matches the calculated PBD speed restriction.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction recomputation only on input change
test_cases.preconditions: A PBD speed restriction is currently active and calculated based on a specific set of inputs.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. A new PBD profile with identical inputs to the current one. 2. A new PBD profile with a changed PBD distance.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or allows observation of calculation events.

steps.action: Send a new PBD profile from trackside with identical inputs to the currently active restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU does not recompute the speed restriction; the existing restriction remains unchanged.

steps.action: Send a new PBD profile from trackside with a different permitted braking distance.
steps.expected: The OBU recomputes the speed restriction and applies the new value.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions for PBD speed restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with known parameters for rotating mass, safe/expected deceleration, and fixed assumptions (T41, T_bs1, T_bs2, T_traction, V_delta0).
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with a specific gradient and PBD distance. Trackside data includes adhesion profiles and brake-inhibition conditions (which should be ignored).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal calculation parameters are accessible or verifiable via logs/analysis.

steps.action: Send a PBD profile with a non-zero gradient and trackside data containing adhesion profiles and brake-inhibition conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the rotating-mass-compensated gradient value for the calculation.

steps.action: Verify the deceleration curves used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The safe deceleration curve ignores trackside adhesion profiles and brake-inhibition/powerless-section conditions. The expected deceleration curve ignores brake-inhibition/powerless-section conditions.

steps.action: Verify the EBD and SBD curves (if service brake is selected).
steps.expected: The EBD curve reaches zero speed at the permitted braking distance. If service brake is selected, the SBD curve also reaches zero speed at the permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Verify the fixed assumptions used in the calculation.
steps.expected: Estimated acceleration is set to zero. Speed-inaccuracy compensation, processing delay (T41), brake feedback (T_bs1, T_bs2), and traction cut-off (T_traction) are applied as fixed values per SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4, regardless of actual configuration.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation for emergency brake
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Trackside requests PBD to be respected using the emergency brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile specifying emergency brake and a PBD distance that allows a non-zero speed restriction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's calculation of the EBD-based inequalities is verifiable.

steps.action: Send a PBD profile specifying emergency brake and a PBD distance that allows a non-zero speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU computes the PBD speed restriction as the speed satisfying the EBD-based inequalities of SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6.

steps.action: Verify the rounding of the computed speed restriction.
steps.expected: The resulting speed restriction is rounded down to the next lower multiple of 5 km/h.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction set to zero when no speed satisfies inequalities
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Trackside requests PBD to be respected using the emergency brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile specifying emergency brake and a very short PBD distance such that no speed satisfies the EBD-based inequalities.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's calculation of the EBD-based inequalities is verifiable.

steps.action: Send a PBD profile specifying emergency brake and a PBD distance that is too short for any speed to satisfy the EBD-based inequalities.
steps.expected: The OBU computes the PBD speed restriction as 0 km/h.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: Tunnel stopping area data is stored on-board. Display of tunnel stopping area is enabled. Train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed, position, and estimated front end offset.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is distinct from the 'max safe front end' and is calculated by the OBU based on current speed and driver reaction time.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the calculated point C (in rear of the tunnel stopping area start point D).
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is displayed to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the start location (point D) of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is no longer displayed, and the 'Tunnel stopping area' information is displayed.

test_cases.title: Sound horn area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: Sound horn area data is stored on-board. Train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed, position, and estimated front end offset.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is used for the start evaluation of the sound horn area as per requirement 5.18.9.2.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the calculated point C (in rear of the sound horn area start point D).
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is displayed to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the end location (point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Verification of estimated front end usage vs max safe front end
test_cases.preconditions: Tunnel stopping area data is stored. The distance between the estimated front end and the max safe front end is significant (e.g., due to high speed or long train).
test_cases.test_inputs: High train speed to maximize the difference between estimated and max safe front end positions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the estimated front end differently from the max safe front end, typically placing the estimated front end further back to account for driver reaction time.

steps.action: Position the train such that the max safe front end is in rear of point C, but the estimated front end is in advance of point C (or at point C).
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is displayed, confirming that the estimated front end, not the max safe front end, triggers the indication.

test_cases.title: Uygunluk kontrolü: Yük profili (Loading Gauge) eşleşmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi: Kabul edilen yük profilleri listesi ['G1', 'G2'].

steps.action: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yük profili 'G1'in kabul edilen listede olduğunu tespit eder. Uygunluk hatası (unsuitability) oluşmaz. Geçici EOA veya SvL oluşturulmaz.

test_cases.title: Uygunluk kontrolü: Yük profili (Loading Gauge) eşleşmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde geçerli Train Data yüklüdür. Yük profili (Loading Gauge) 'G3' olarak tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi: Kabul edilen yük profilleri listesi ['G1', 'G2'].

steps.action: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yük profili 'G3'ün kabul edilen listede olmadığını tespit eder. Uygunluk hatası (unsuitability) oluşur. Sürücüye uygunluk hatası bildirimi yapılır.

test_cases.title: Uygunluk kontrolü: Aks yük kategorisi (Axle Load) eşleşmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde geçerli Train Data yüklüdür. Aks yük kategorisi 'C' olarak tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi: İzin verilen aks yük kategorileri listesi ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].

steps.expected: OBU, aks yük kategorisi 'C'nin izin verilen listede olduğunu tespit eder. Uygunluk hatası (unsuitability) oluşmaz.

test_cases.title: Uygunluk kontrolü: Aks yük kategorisi (Axle Load) eşleşmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde geçerli Train Data yüklüdür. Aks yük kategorisi 'E' olarak tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi: İzin verilen aks yük kategorileri listesi ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].

steps.action: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, aks yük kategorisi 'E'nin izin verilen listede olmadığını tespit eder. Uygunluk hatası (unsuitability) oluşur. Sürücüye uygunluk hatası bildirimi yapılır.

test_cases.title: Uygunluk kontrolü: Çekiş sistemi (Traction System) eşleşmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde geçerli Train Data yüklüdür. Lokomotifin kabul ettiği çekiş sistemleri listesi ['25kV AC', '15kV AC'] olarak tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi: Çekiş sistemi '25kV AC'.

steps.expected: OBU, yerden gelen çekiş sisteminin lokomotifin kabul ettiği listede olduğunu tespit eder. Uygunluk hatası (unsuitability) oluşmaz.

test_cases.title: Uygunluk kontrolü: Çekiş sistemi (Traction System) eşleşmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde geçerli Train Data yüklüdür. Lokomotifin kabul ettiği çekiş sistemleri listesi ['25kV AC'] olarak tanımlıdır. Lokomotifin çeksiz hatlarda çalışabilme özelliği yoktur.

steps.action: Yerden gelen Route Suitability verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yerden gelen çekiş sisteminin lokomotifin kabul ettiği listede olmadığını tespit eder. Uygunluk hatası (unsuitability) oluşur. Sürücüye uygunluk hatası bildirimi yapılır.

test_cases.title: Çekiş sistemi istisnası: Çeksiz hatlarda çalışabilme yeteneği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU üzerinde geçerli Train Data yüklüdür. Lokomotifin kabul ettiği çekiş sistemleri listesi ['25kV AC'] olarak tanımlıdır. Lokomotifin çeksiz hatlarda çalışabilme özelliği vardır (Train Data'da işaretli).

test_cases.title: Route Suitability verisinin olmaması: Varsayılan değer kullanılmaması
